type: Single frozen JSON-scalar-projection template: 10 development and 20 untouched holdout inputs, two arms, one response each. Assistant-authored synthetic scope, not an external benchmark.
candidate_selection: One manually authored candidate frozen before all calls. No candidate selection, revision, or retest from development or holdout outputs. Development requests precede holdout; paired arms shuffled within split.
admission: Both arms must pass every exact projection check in both splits; all charges must match request IDs and reconcile the counter; compressed charges plus the full preparation fee must be strictly lower within each split.
preparation: Manual/local authoring, no translation or generation API calls. Human labor cost is unknown.
tokenizer: o200k_base proxy, not an authenticated gateway model tokenizer.
limitations: 30 distinct synthetic payloads share one fixed schema and transformation; not 30 independent task types.
One call per payload/arm does not establish repeated reliability.
Model label and gateway accounting are unverified. Charges are displayed credits, not an invoice.
This exact JSON projection is deterministically computable without an LLM; the study tests admission machinery, not a reason to use an LLM for projection.
Production compressed answers still require exact runtime validation and original fallback. Fallback charges can erase measured savings.
Original-only default remains unchanged. Experimental admission is specific to target/config, tokenizer and this template.
